verdict.rationale: Kimi documents an API: Kimi Code is OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible, and platform.kimi.ai has docs and an llms.txt. That makes an interactive API reference a fair question for this product, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference with runnable or try-it examples. Protocol compatibility and API-key management are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
